details: Damage Transfer can move a fatal wound to a less important part of Klein's own body at this stage.
Flaming Jump lets him move between prepared sparks or nearby flames within roughly 30 meters.
Air Bullets can be fired by snapping or mimicking sounds with power comparable to a custom revolver.
Paper Figurine Substitute can take a fatal blow and reduce damage from hexes.
Flame Controlling manipulates or ignites flames within roughly 30 meters.
Illusion Creation can reproduce convincing colors, sounds and smells.
Emlyn locates a Thousand-faced Hunter mutated pituitary gland and its blood.
The quoted price is 2,000 pounds for the pituitary gland and 300 pounds for 100 ml of blood.
Klein is still missing the Human-skinned Shadow characteristic and Deep-sea Naga hair at this point.
Alger reports a usable channel for Deep-sea Naga hair at 100 pounds per strand.
Klein orders five strands and continues treating the Human-skinned Shadow characteristic as the final major bottleneck.
The Machinery Hivemind operation produces a Human-skinned Shadow characteristic.
Klein is explicitly allowed to choose an item from the operation's gains and identifies the characteristic he needs.
A Psychology Alchemists route also exists, but the Machinery Hivemind route gives him the better immediate option.
Klein reconfirms the complete Faceless recipe before concocting the potion.
After consuming it, he explicitly recognizes that he has crossed the threshold into Sequence 6.
Initial body alteration is limited: height changes of about 10 cm are practical, while much larger structural changes are not.
He can rapidly reproduce outward appearance and temperament but does not gain the target's memories or knowledge.
Cattleya offers Klein a pair of six-winged gargoyle eyes for 300 pounds.
Klein notes that drago bark and Sonia Island Golden Spring water are comparatively common supplementary materials.
Klein lays out the accumulated supplementary materials including Sonia Golden Spring water, drago bark, six-winged gargoyle eyes and remnant ancient-wraith spirituality.
He uses the purified All-Black Eye as the effective Marionettist characteristic/main ingredient source.
The potion is consumed while mermaids sing, satisfying the advancement ritual.
Spirit Body Threads reveal hidden living targets and are particularly useful against concealment or invisibility.
Initial control makes thought and movement sluggish before full conversion into a marionette.
At the start of Sequence 5, Klein estimates about 20 seconds for initial control and about five minutes for full conversion if uninterrupted.
A completed marionette retains its original Beyonder powers and can use mystical items with its own spirituality.
His early practical limits include roughly 100 meters for seeing threads, about 5 meters to begin control, and one simultaneously controlled marionette.
Zaratul provides the Bizarro Sorcerer formula in the foggy town.
The two main ingredients are the Bizarro Bane's main eye and the true soul body of a Spirit World Plunderer.
The ritual requires a grand public performance in which the advancer kills a demigod-level creature through their own strength and strategy, then drinks the potion at the curtain call.
Klein successfully hunts a Spirit World Plunderer in Calderón City.
He confirms that the resulting true soul body is one of the Bizarro Sorcerer main ingredients.
Klein lends the Spirit World Plunderer true soul body to Derrick as bait because of its intense attraction to a Bizarro Bane/Shapeshifter.
The City of Silver expedition kills the attracted Shapeshifter.
Colin Iliad collects its blood while the remaining ingredient/characteristic forms, allowing the material to enter the exchange chain for Klein.
Klein realizes that the advancement performance functions as an early anchor for a pathway whose Soul Body fragments during demigod advancement.
He can transform into similarly sized animals and transfer wounds from himself or others to paper figurines.
Flaming Jump expands to nearly one kilometer and Air Bullet power reaches cannon level.
Initial Spirit Body Thread control drops to about three seconds and full marionette conversion to about fifteen seconds.
Marionettes can use his own Beyonder powers, and he can exchange positions with them within roughly one kilometer.
The resulting body-double system makes it extremely difficult to distinguish Klein from a marionette in combat.
The Scholar of Yore formula names Hound of Fulgrim eyes and a Demonic Wolf of Fog transformed heart as the main ingredients.
Supplementary materials include Hound of Fulgrim blood, White Frost Crystal and a large amount of genuine ancient historical records.
The ritual requires being separated from reality for at least 300 years and advancing after effectively becoming history.
Klein performs a sacrificial/bestowment exchange with the Evernight Goddess.
He receives the Demonic Wolf of Fog transformed heart and White Frost Crystal needed for the Scholar of Yore potion.
Klein uses the Demonic Wolf material as bait in the spirit world.
Hounds of Fulgrim appear, and he obtains their eyes and blood, completing the rare-material side of the potion preparation.
Klein can borrow power from his own past self through the Historical Void.
He can summon Historical Void projections of people or objects, with success depending on knowledge, target level and affinity.
He can maintain up to three summoned historical images at one time at this stage.
Objects he once possessed can be summoned back as temporary historical projections.
His Spirit Body Thread control and marionette ranges are also substantially improved at Sequence 3.
The Miracle Invoker formula requires either the Dark Demonic Wolf/God of Wishes heart or another Miracle Invoker characteristic.
Supplementary materials are 300 ml of Dark Demonic Wolf blood, one Worm of Time and one Worm of Star.
The ritual is to return a piece of history that has been left behind to the present era.
Klein distinguishes 'returning' history from simply reproducing or documenting it.
He identifies the City of Silver leaving the Forsaken Land of the Gods as a valid large-scale interpretation of the ritual.
Wishes are not freely usable at arbitrary scale.
A Miracle Invoker must first fulfill other people's wishes and accumulate them step by step.
Only after that accumulation can increasingly large wishes and true miracles be granted.
The Fool Card gives one Attendant of Mysteries characteristic as the main ingredient and nine spirit-world specialties as supplements.
The ritual requires an entirely marionette-populated town whose individual fates and interactions become realistic enough to form a corresponding spirit-world region.
Klein already has many marionettes stored above the gray fog and recognizes why such a population is relevant.
Regenerate restores vanished Spirit Body Threads to eligible matter and can turn it into a marionette.
Reassembly/Tampering, which Klein prefers to conceptualize as Grafting, can combine physical objects or abstract concepts into altered relationships and effects.
Realm of Mysteries creates an embryonic divine kingdom with concealment properties.
The Fool requires the pathway Uniqueness plus two additional Attendant of Mysteries characteristics.
The supplementary condition is control of at least one quarter of the fog of history.
The advancement ritual is to fool time, history or fate once.
